mapper.sql: file_id, user_id, file_name, object_key, file_size, content_type, content_hash, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from ai_user_file where del_flag = '0' and file_id = #{fileId} and user_id = #{userId}
select coalesce(sum(file_size), 0) from ai_user_file where del_flag = '0' and user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from ai_user_file where del_flag = '0' and user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from ai_user_file where del_flag = '0' and object_key = #{objectKey}

select f.file_id, f.user_id, f.file_name, f.object_key, f.file_size, f.content_type, f.content_hash, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_time, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName from ai_user_file f left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id
f.del_flag = '0' and f.user_id = #{userId}
and f.file_name like concat('%', #{fileName}, '%')
and f.content_type like concat(#{contentType}, '%')
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{createBy}, '%')
order by f.create_time desc, f.file_id desc

select f.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, count(1) as fileCount, sum(f.file_size) as usedBytes from ai_user_file f left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id where f.del_flag = '0' group by f.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name order by usedBytes desc
select count(1) as fileCount, ifnull(sum(file_size), 0) as usedBytes, count(distinct user_id) as userCount from ai_user_file where del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into ai_user_file (user_id, file_name, object_key, file_size, content_type, content_hash, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{objectKey}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{contentHash}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update ai_user_file set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where file_id = #{fileId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
